_comment: Codex hook wiring for Assertion memory. Mirrors the Claude Code hooks.json (Codex uses the same hooks.json shape and event names: SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop). It invokes the SAME shared scripts in ../scripts — one copy of the logic for both agents; the scripts auto-detect Codex vs Claude Code from the stdin shape. Set ASSERTION_SCRIPTS_DIR to the absolute path of the scripts dir (or, in a packaged Codex bundle, swap to Codex's bundle-root variable).
